negative_cases.unknown_workstream: An explicit WorkstreamId absent from the canonical ProjectState returns UnknownWorkstream and leaves the selection cursor unchanged.
negative_cases.foreign_workstream_scope: A same-ID WorkstreamKey with a different ScopeRef fails exact registered-owner validation and cannot mutate selection.
negative_cases.cross_project_key: A ProjectState containing Workstream entries from more than one ScopeRef fails closed with CrossProjectWorkstream; no project is inferred.
negative_cases.stale_revision: A non-idempotent request whose expected revision differs from the canonical selection revision returns StaleRevision without mutation.
negative_cases.stale_fencing_token: A request with a stale expected fencing cursor returns StaleFencingToken without mutation.
negative_cases.continuity_only: WorkstreamRequestEnvelope extraction rejects a continuity-only request before ActiveWorkstreamCommand construction.
negative_cases.idempotency_conflict: Reusing an idempotency key for a different exact command fails closed; an exact replay returns the original event/Receipt without a second revision.
negative_cases.presentation_authority: The request carries actor/context only; the active selection field is private and is changed only by the canonical reducer result. No CWD, tab, recent session, continuity-only, latest-record, or daemon-global pointer fallback exists in the active-selection production slice.
